The [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] [[Iunist]] and the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] tyrant [[Gusepp]] once engaged in '''battle'''. Iunist severed the tyrant's forearm, and the encounter subsequently became legendary. [[Gusepp's Hand]] became a valuable artifact.<ref name="Topside Infiltration" />
